     NOTICE OF SUBMISSION OF TESTIMONY, EXHIBIT LIST, AND EXHIBITS

    TO THE HONORABLE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGES AND ALL PARTIES:

COMES NOW John B. Bradley III, Pro Se Intervenor, and respectfully provides
notice that, in accordance with the applicable SOAH Orders 6 and 26 and
prehearing submission requirements, such as PUC Item 5337 ONCOR’s Roadmap
for Hearing Exhibits, he has submitted his Direct Testimony, Exhibit List, and
Exhibits through the required filing and document exchange systems.

Specifically, the testimony, exhibit list, and exhibits have been:

   1. Uploaded to the SOAH Kiteworks portal;
   2. Filed on the PUC Interchange; and
   3. Uploaded to the Oncor Egnyte document repository.

These submissions are intended to satisfy the prehearing exhibit exchange
requirements established by the Administrative Law Judges and to ensure
availability to all parties.
